about: The project cards on the home page, in display order. `make site` renders them into index.html between the projects markers. To add a project: add an entry here, add its page under projects/<slug>/, then run make site. A number's `kpi` and any {key} in its `text` are keys of data/site.json.

projects.title: Dubai Property Market & Mortgage Risk
projects.thumbnail_alt: Executive overview page of the Power BI report: sales value, prices, off-plan and mortgage shares, and market cycles since 2004
summary: How a UAE bank's risk team could value homes, track prices and stress-test its mortgage book, built from Dubai Land Department open data.
An end-to-end pipeline from raw files to a published Power BI report, with a like-for-like price index, a valuation model and a stress test.
